details: @ruthless-imperium/baileys@0.0.0-stage is a namespace-squat placeholder: it publishes the canonical package name "baileys" (the WhatsApp Web library @whiskeysockets/baileys) under the unrelated scope @ruthless-imperium, with no author or repository claim tying it to the upstream project. The tarball contains only package.json and README.md (348 bytes unpacked) and ships no executable code, no lifecycle scripts, no bin entries and no dependencies; package.json describes it as a "Temporary package placeholder for staged publishing" and the version is 0.0.0-stage. This is the name-reservation shape used to hold a trusted-looking package name under a lookalike scope ahead of a payload publish, and the same package name has previously been published with malicious content. This version has no code behaviour and therefore no network IOCs — the analysis is metadata-only, with no runtime payload to describe.
